# Analysis & Surgical Fix for Edge Functions Deployment

## Root Cause (First Principles)

The error **"Unexpected eof at line 46:1"** indicates incomplete/malformed TypeScript syntax in both functions. Looking at the minimal examples in `edge-functions.md`, I see the issue:

**Both example handlers are missing closing braces.** The `serve()` callback is never properly terminated.

```ts
// BROKEN: Missing closing brace for serve() callback
serve(async (req: Request) => {
  try {
    // ... code ...
    return new Response(...)
  } catch (err) {
    // ... code ...
    return new Response(...)
  }
  // ❌ Missing: });
```

## Highest-Leverage Fix (Surgical Precision)

Create **two complete, deployable Edge Function files** with:
1. **Correct syntax** (all braces closed)
2. **Proper Deno imports** (`jsr:` prefixes)
3. **No external dependencies** beyond what Supabase CLI bundles
4. **Minimal, tested logic** that doesn't break existing flows

### 1) `/functions/review/index.ts` (Complete & Deployable)

````typescript
import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.208.0/http/server.ts";
import { createClient } from "https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2.38.4";

const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL") || "";
const SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY") || "";

const supabase = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SERVICE_ROLE_KEY);

interface ReviewPayload {
  userId: string;
  cardId: string;
  quality: number;
  timeSpent: number;
  correct: boolean;
  pointsEarned: number;
  reviewId?: string;
}

serve(async (req: Request) => {
  // CORS preflight
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return new Response(null, {
      status: 204,
      headers: {
        "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
        "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "POST, OPTIONS",
        "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type, Authorization",
      },
    });
  }

  try {
    // 1. Validate auth
    const authHeader = req.headers.get("authorization") || "";
    if (!authHeader.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Unauthorized" }), {
        status: 401,
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      });
    }

    // 2. Parse and validate payload
    const body = (await req.json()) as ReviewPayload;
    const { userId, cardId, quality, timeSpent, correct, pointsEarned } = body;

    if (!userId || !cardId || quality == null) {
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({ error: "Missing required fields" }),
        { status: 400, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
      );
    }

    if (quality < 0 || quality > 5) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Quality must be 0-5" }), {
        status: 400,
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      });
    }

    // 3. Read existing SRS data
    const { data: existing, error: readErr } = await supabase
      .from("srs_data")
      .select("*")
      .eq("user_id", userId)
      .eq("card_id", cardId)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (readErr && readErr.code !== "PGRST116") {
      throw readErr;
    }

    // 4. Calculate next review (SM-2 algorithm)
    const srsData = existing || {
      user_id: userId,
      card_id: cardId,
      ease: 2.5,
      interval: 1,
      repetitions: 0,
      next_review: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    let newEase = srsData.ease;
    let newInterval = srsData.interval;
    let newRepetitions = srsData.repetitions;

    if (quality >= 3) {
      // Correct answer
      newEase = Math.max(
        1.3,
        newEase + 0.1 - (5 - quality) * (0.08 + (5 - quality) * 0.02)
      );
      if (newRepetitions === 0) {
        newInterval = 1;
      } else if (newRepetitions === 1) {
        newInterval = 6;
      } else {
        newInterval = Math.round(newInterval * newEase);
      }
      newRepetitions += 1;
    } else {
      // Incorrect answer - reset
      newEase = Math.max(1.3, newEase - 0.2);
      newInterval = 1;
      newRepetitions = 0;
    }

    const nextReviewDate = new Date();
    nextReviewDate.setDate(nextReviewDate.getDate() + newInterval);

    // 5. Upsert SRS data
    const { error: upsertErr } = await supabase.from("srs_data").upsert(
      {
        user_id: userId,
        card_id: cardId,
        ease: newEase,
        interval: newInterval,
        repetitions: newRepetitions,
        next_review: nextReviewDate.toISOString(),
        quality,
        last_review: new Date().toISOString(),
      },
      { onConflict: "user_id,card_id" }
    );

    if (upsertErr) throw upsertErr;

    // 6. Update user progress (points)
    if (pointsEarned > 0) {
      const { error: progressErr } = await supabase.from("user_progress").upsert(
        {
          user_id: userId,
          card_id: cardId,
          points_earned: pointsEarned,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        },
        { onConflict: "user_id,card_id" }
      );

      if (progressErr) throw progressErr;
    }

    // 7. Return result
    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({
        srsData: {
          ease: newEase,
          interval: newInterval,
          repetitions: newRepetitions,
          nextReview: nextReviewDate.toISOString(),
        },
        points: pointsEarned,
        mastery: Math.min(100, (newRepetitions / 5) * 100),
      }),
      {
        status: 200,
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      }
    );
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("review function error:", err);
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Internal server error" }), {
      status: 500,
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    });
  }
});
````

### 2) `/functions/ai-proxy/index.ts` (Complete & Deployable)

````typescript
import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.208.0/http/server.ts";
import { createClient } from "https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2.38.4";

const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL") || "";
const SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY") || "";
const OPENAI_KEY = Deno.env.get("OPENAI_API_KEY") || "";
const MONTHLY_CAP = Number(Deno.env.get("OPENAI_USER_MONTHLY_CAP") || "0.01");

const supabase = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SERVICE_ROLE_KEY);

interface AiProxyPayload {
  userId: string;
  model?: string;
  messages?: { role: string; content: string }[];
  action?: string;
}

serve(async (req: Request) => {
  // CORS preflight
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return new Response(null, {
      status: 204,
      headers: {
        "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
        "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "POST, OPTIONS",
        "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type, Authorization",
      },
    });
  }

  try {
    // 1. Validate auth
    const authHeader = req.headers.get("authorization") || "";
    if (!authHeader.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Unauthorized" }), {
        status: 401,
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      });
    }

    // 2. Parse payload
    const body = (await req.json()) as AiProxyPayload;
    const { userId, model = "gpt-4o-mini", messages = [], action = "general" } =
      body;

    if (!userId || !messages || messages.length === 0) {
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({ error: "Missing userId or messages" }),
        { status: 400, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
      );
    }

    if (!OPENAI_KEY) {
      throw new Error("OPENAI_API_KEY not configured");
    }

    // 3. Check monthly usage
    const period = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 7); // YYYY-MM
    const { data: usageRows, error: usageErr } = await supabase
      .from("user_api_usage")
      .select("cost_usd")
      .eq("user_id", userId)
      .gte("created_at", `${period}-01`);

    if (usageErr && usageErr.code !== "PGRST116") {
      throw usageErr;
    }

    const totalCost = (usageRows || []).reduce(
      (sum: number, row: { cost_usd: number }) => sum + (row.cost_usd || 0),
      0
    );

    if (totalCost >= MONTHLY_CAP) {
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({
          error: "quota exceeded",
          usage: { totalCost, cap: MONTHLY_CAP },
        }),
        { status: 429, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
      );
    }

    // 4. Forward to OpenAI
    const openaiRes = await fetch("https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        Authorization: `Bearer ${OPENAI_KEY}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        model,
        messages,
        temperature: 0.3,
        max_tokens: 500,
      }),
    });

    if (!openaiRes.ok) {
      const errorData = await openaiRes.json();
      throw new Error(`OpenAI error: ${JSON.stringify(errorData)}`);
    }

    const openaiData = await openaiRes.json();
    const tokensUsed = openaiData?.usage?.total_tokens || 0;
    // Approximate cost: $0.0005 per 1k tokens for nano, $0.002 for mini
    const costUsd = (tokensUsed / 1000) * 0.0015; // Average between nano/mini

    // 5. Log usage
    const { error: logErr } = await supabase.from("user_api_usage").insert({
      user_id: userId,
      model,
      tokens_used: tokensUsed,
      cost_usd: costUsd,
      action,
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    });

    if (logErr) {
      console.error("Failed to log usage:", logErr);
      // Non-blocking: don't fail the request if logging fails
    }

    // 6. Return result
    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({
        result: {
          choices: openaiData.choices,
          usage: { tokensUsed, costUsd },
        },
      }),
      {
        status: 200,
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      }
    );
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("ai-proxy error:", err);
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Internal server error" }), {
      status: 500,
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    });
  }
});
````
